questions.question: What's our liability if there's a data breach?
questions.expected_answer: Unlimited liability for any data breach (Clause 15.1).

questions.question: How fast must we tell them about a breach?
questions.expected_answer: Immediately upon becoming aware of a security incident (Clause 9.3).

questions.question: How many days do we have to delete their data after exit?
questions.expected_answer: Within fifteen days of termination or expiry (Clause 18.2).

questions.question: When can the bank audit us?
questions.expected_answer: At any time without prior notice.

questions.question: Do we have to share our security reports with anyone?
questions.expected_answer: Yes, with the bank's technology service providers on request.

questions.question: What uptime do we have to guarantee?
When must they pay our invoices?
What is the cap on our liability?
Will we receive real employee data during the pilot?
questions.expected_answer: No, only synthetic test data supplied by the client.
